text:
sam-sales: CedarCare POC kickoff. They want Redwood Private in their AWS account. Constraints: egress must go via their TLS-inspect proxy, SOC requires original client IPs in logs, and they need a tiny static allowlist for firewall change window. Can ops/SE propose a minimal plan?

ira-netops: Two quick topologies: 1) PrivateLink (interface endpoint) to our connector: low customer infra but ENI IPs are per-AZ and can change; if proxy SNATs you'll only see proxy IPs unless proxy injects X-Forwarded-For. 2) Deploy connector in-customer VPC with NLB (TCP) + 2 EIPs: preferred for audits because NLB preserves client IP at TCP layer and EIPs are stable for allowlisting.

veli-se: TL;DR on TLS/mTLS: if you need mTLS terminate on connector and validate client certs. If proxy inspects TLS, ask them to avoid SNAT or forward X-Forwarded-For. ALB will hide source IP unless X-Forwarded-For is used; use NLB for IP preservation.

nora-ps: Cost note: PrivateLink adds AWS endpoint hourly + per-GB charges; connector-in-VPC means customer pays EC2/NLB/EIP but we can offer a short POC infra credit.

infra-bot: Provisioned ephemeral POC stack in acct 444555666777 (us-east-1). id: cedar-poc-3401. NLB created, awaiting EIP assignment.

ira-netops: Pasteable firewall ticket (pick variant):
Variant A (recommended, stable IPs):
Allow TCP/443 from App Subnet 10.50.0.0/22 to Connector NLB EIPs 198.51.100.99 and 198.51.100.100 (outbound).
Allow TCP/443 from Connector EIPs to App LB SG for callbacks (inbound) if needed.
Variant B (PrivateLink):
Allow TCP/443 from App Subnet to Interface Endpoint ENI IPs (ENIs provided after creation). Note ENI IPs may change if endpoint is recreated.

sam-sales: Owners: ira -> final 1-page runbook + firewall snippet (EOD tomorrow); veli -> security questionnaire lines for mTLS/KMS/log-forwarding; nora -> POC credit blurb for quote. I'll schedule handoff call during change window.

sam-sales: One-liner for SOC ticket: "To preserve original client IPs, use an NLB TCP passthrough (preferred) or configure your TLS proxy to forward X-Forwarded-For and avoid SNAT for these flows."
